subject.title: Google Chat: markdown renders as raw text; typing indicator says 'OpenClaw is typing' instead of app name

question: Should Google Chat normalize assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported text syntax, strip unsupported Markdown to plain text, or keep raw Markdown behavior and only fix the typing name fallback?
rationale: The typing fix is straightforward, but the prior markdown PR was challenged because stripping all formatting may be worse than converting the supported Google Chat subset; this needs owner intent before an automated fix should proceed.

options.title: Convert Supported Syntax
options.body: Add a Google Chat-owned formatter for supported emphasis/link/code cases, strip only unsupported constructs, and cover both inbound replies and message-tool sends.

options.title: Plain Text Only
options.body: Strip Markdown before sending to Google Chat, accepting loss of formatting in exchange for simpler and predictable output.

options.title: Typing Only For Now
options.body: Land the identity.name fallback and leave Markdown behavior unchanged until a separate rendering design is approved.

recommendation.title: Convert Supported Syntax
recommendation.body: Add a Google Chat-owned formatter for supported emphasis/link/code cases, strip only unsupported constructs, and cover both inbound replies and message-tool sends.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across Google Chat monitor, reply-delivery, and plugin-boundary refactors relevant to this product/API decision.
